description: This file is the main activity for an Android application targeting Wear OS devices, managing UI interactions, notifications, gesture detection, and delayed confirmation.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class handling UI events, notifications, timers, gestures, and interactions specific to a wearable Android app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method initializing the activity, setting up views, gesture detectors, and overlay views.

methods.name: dispatchTouchEvent
methods.description: Intercepts touch events to detect long press gestures.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Creates and displays a notification with an action linking to GridExampleActivity.

methods.name: onFinishActivity
methods.description: Handles user request to finish activity and return to previous screen.

methods.name: onStartTimer
methods.description: Initiates a countdown timer using DelayedConfirmationView.

methods.name: onTimerFinished
methods.description: Callback invoked when the timer completes, initiating scroll up.

methods.name: onTimerSelected
methods.description: Callback invoked when the timer is selected/canceled, initiating scroll up.

methods.name: scroll
methods.description: Performs scrolling of the ScrollView in specified direction.
